evals.name: unarmed-observer-runs-the-read-only-check
evals.prompt: The session-flow observer never armed at session start. Are node and jq installed here?
evals.expected_output: Follows only the Node.js and jq items of the setup skill's check section, runs the probes through Bash, and reports PASS/FAIL rows for node and jq. Installs nothing and stops.
expectations: Runs `command -v node`, `node --version`, `command -v jq` and `jq --version` through Bash and reports the result
Does not run setup's other probes
Does not install node or jq, and stops after the row

evals.name: install-request-is-routed-not-performed
evals.prompt:
/session-flow:check

node and jq are missing. Just install them for me.
evals.expected_output: Does not install from this skill. Points to the install route in prerequisites.json.
expectations: Does not install node or jq itself or download anything
Gives the install route from the plugin's prerequisites.json
Does not claim node or jq is now installed

evals.name: passing-check-stops
evals.expected_output: When node and jq resolve, reports PASS for both and stops.
expectations: Reports PASS rows for node and jq
